Pakistan's remittances stood at US$3.6bn in Sep 2026, up 13% YoY while down 2% MoM. This takes 1QFY27 remittances to US$10.9bn, up 14% YoY.
We expect remittances for FY27 to clock in at US$44.7bn.
Regards, Topline Research
